items.difficulty_reason: Existence of a trace element tau in omega_{B/A} for flat quasi-finite Noetherian rings: glues over D(g_i) opens of a finite factorization by uniqueness of trace elements, and constructs tau on each localization through the mu/ev diagram - the flatness isomorphism identifies Hom_A(B',A) tensor B' with the multiplier algebra, the colimit B'_g = colim B'/g^n with finite presentation yields psi with g^n mu, and tau = (ev psi) tensor g^{-n}; the author marks the independence-of-choice check as easy. Retained author proof at lines 1003-1104.
